optimization.note: Verified resource-priority setting: keeps 95% HLS accuracy and 100% argmax match on the 20-sample recognition check. Compared with the original fixed<12,6>/RF1024/10ns profile, this layer precision profile plus 15ns target reduces DSP 67->64, FF 10265->5999, and LUT 20400->17899 without changing the model topology.

demo.description: Real MNIST digit-recognition demo: trained MLP weights are converted to HLS, Vivado csim compares HLS logits with ONNX reference logits, and summary reports classification accuracy.
